title: Lesson 4: Diagnose the Fault
goal: This circuit was working yesterday and the LED is dark today. Find what broke, fix it with a click or a new part, and light the LED.
hints: The switch is closed, so that is not it. Select components and check the meter readings.
A burned-out component reads 0V across itself even with power connected: no current can pass.
LEDs die from too much current. led1 is dead: delete it, place a fresh one, keep r1 in series as its bodyguard.
